capabilities: ask questions answered from your knowledge base
configure an OpenAI API key in settings
extras: README warns that loading your data sends all your markdown files to OpenAI for scanning.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask a language model questions answered from the contents of your own notes.
summary: AI assistant that trains a GPT-3 based model on your notes via OpenAI embeddings and answers questions from your knowledge base.
